lines.text: When a watchman sees the sword coming and blows the ram's horn, anyone who ignores it will have his blood on his own head.
If the watchman sees the sword coming and fails to blow the horn, God will hold the watchman accountable for the blood.
God makes Ezekiel a watchman for the land of Egypt and tells him to give the warning from Him.
Israel says their sins are heavy and asks how they can live, and God says He takes no pleasure in the death of the wicked.
A wicked man who turns from his sin and offers a hundred bulls will surely live, and none of his sins will be held against him.

wrong_details.true: restores a pledge, makes restitution for what he has stolen
